title: Vocabulary with pictures: Match 3 pictures (`vocab-match3`) and 1 picture, 3 words (`vocab-pick3`), the lesson vocabulary page and the picture set

template.also: The same card covers `vocab-pick3` (js/modules/sheet/cells/vocab-pick3.js), the shared picture set (js/modules/sheet/graphics/vocab-pictures.js, graphic library), the lesson word sets (js/modules/sheet/lesson-pages/vocab-words.js), the lesson part `vocab-page` (js/modules/sheet/lesson-pages/vocab-pages.js, registered in lesson-pages/index.js) and the generator branch `_genPictureTask` (js/modules/gen-vocabulary.js) with its provider (js/modules/sheet/providers/vocabulary.js). screen-cell.js draws the same cells on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz.

summary: The owner's vocabulary redesign (2026-10-25, IMPROVEMENT_PLAN 'Vocabulary redesign and the graphic library'), scoped by the owner on 2026-11-07 to the words of the 64 CCSS BUILD lessons, earliest rounds first (round 1 = 11 BUILD lessons, the pilot unit G3-Y4.B4 first). Two problem types, each one boxed cell: MATCH 3 PICTURES (three pictures lettered A B C, three words; write the letter beside each word; 4 a page) and 1 PICTURE, 3 WORDS (copy the right word from a bank of three onto a line; K-1 4, grades 2-3 6, grades 4-5 8 a page). One shared picture set (47 black-and-white drawings, the graphic library) serves the lesson's opening vocabulary page AND the practice skills. Each task kind is also a findable preset skill.
teaches: The language of the lessons, not one standard: each word set is the vocabulary of one CCSS BUILD lesson (round 1: 1.NBT.A.1, 2.NBT.A.3, 3.OA.B.5, 3.OA.C.7, 3.OA.D.8, 3.OA.D.9, 4.OA.A.1, 4.OA.A.3, 4.OA.C.5), decided from the standard's text and, where a long lesson exists, its own vocabulary (owner 2026-11-07: decide from the standards). Receptive (match a word to its picture) then productive (copy the word that names a picture) - the catalogue's VC-R1 and VC-P1 rungs (design/catalogue/vocabulary.md).
research: From repo sources: design/catalogue/vocabulary.md (the family audit: ladders VC-R / VC-P, the defects of today's six-variant mix), the owner's design in IMPROVEMENT_PLAN, the owner's 10-17 letter change (design/lesson-planner/wip-2026-10-17/vocab-letters.uncommitted.patch, superseded by the 10-25 design: the PICTURES are lettered and the box is beside the WORD), data/standards/ccss-math.json for the word sets, the detailed lessons' own vocabulary. MathWorksheets4Kids / IXL not opened this round (budget; the owner's design is explicit and outranks them): their vocabulary pages are picture-word matching with lines and a word bank, the same grammar in a denser layout.
problemTypes: Match 3 pictures (vocab-match3): three pictures in a row lettered A, B, C; under them the three words in another order (never a word under its own picture), each with one letter box; the pupil writes the picture's letter in each box. Screen: the same three letter boxes, one character each (type the letter): the response is the same, never multiple choice.

1 picture, 3 words (vocab-pick3): one picture, a bank of three words in a thin box under it, a writing line; the pupil copies the right word onto the line. Screen: the three words are buttons; a tap drops the word onto the line (the cell's :has() rule), one graded answer.

The lesson vocabulary page (lesson part vocab-page, a lesson whose record names its vocabSet): band 'Match the pictures:' two Match 3 cells (all six words), band 'Name the picture:' 1-picture cells for the core words (K-1 and grades 2-3: 2, grades 4-5: 4); key on the facsimile page.
progression: Match 3 pictures (receptive: recognise the word; three pairs, the picture labelled) -> 1 picture, 3 words (productive: choose and write the word). One change a step (P-1): the response changes from a letter to a word.
One lesson's six words (vocabSet) -> every word of the grade's lessons (vocabGrade): the pool grows, the task does not change.
A page uses every word of its pool once before any word comes back; no item offers two words whose pictures could be read the same (notWith), so every item has one right answer.

drawing.sizes: Pictures on a 60 x 40 canvas scaled to the width the cell gives: Match 3 at 38 / 40 / 40 mm (S / M / L); 1 picture, 3 words at 80 / 40 / 34 mm for grades K-1 / 2-3 / 4-5 (x 0.88 at S, x 0.94 at M). Strokes non-scaling: structure / the named mark 1.5 pt, parts 1 pt, fine rules 0.75 pt. Picture text >= 5.8 canvas units (11 pt at 40 mm). Match 3: letters A B C at text + 5 pt, words at text + 3 pt bold, letter box Hw + 2 mm square, 1.5 pt. 1 picture: bank words at text + 5 / + 2 / + 1 pt (K-1 / 2-3 / 4-5) in a 0.75 pt box, one line when they fit else one word a line; the writing line 1.5 pt, as wide as the longest bank word. Cell minimum heights 96 / 61 / 45 mm (+ 6 mm cell padding): 2 / 3 / 4 rows on A4 (grid 227 mm) and Letter (209 mm).
drawing.notes: Black ink on white, no grey and no colour in a picture (INK-1). A picture never prints its own word (L-LEAK); the part the word names is its ONE heavy mark (a ring, a box, an outline, an arrow). Words whose pictures could be read as each other list each other in notWith (vocab-words.js) and are never offered in one item. Measured counts (ws-grade-render, independent role): Match 3 = 4 a page and grade-3 picture = 6 a page at S, M and L on A4 and Letter.

ownerRulings.ruling: Two problem types, both one boxed cell: Match 3 pictures (three words, three pictures labelled A, B, C; write the letter in a box beside each word; on screen the letter is chosen per word, same response, no MC swap) and 1 picture, 3 words (one picture, a three-word bank; copy the right word onto a line under the picture; on screen tapping the word drops it onto the line).
ownerRulings.source: design/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md 'Vocabulary redesign and the graphic library' item 1

ownerRulings.ruling: Per page: Match 3 pictures = 4; 1 picture, 3 words: K-1 4, grades 2-3 6, grades 4-6 8.
Pictures very high quality, black and white, drawn by the app; ONE shared set serves the lesson's vocabulary page and the vocabulary practice; every approved drawing joins the graphic library.
Each problem type is a distinct task kind, so it is ALSO a findable preset skill with standards, WRM, search terms and share codes.
Scope: only the 64 CCSS BUILD lessons, their vocabulary first, earliest rounds first. Grade map K = Y1 ... G5 = Y6.
"All as suggested": the card approved as the lane decided it (section 9 answered as recommended).
ownerRulings.source: owner in the lead session, relayed by the lead 2026-11-07

ownerRulings.ruling: Q1: role:lesson is OUT OF SCOPE for vocabulary:vocab_grade_pictures and vocabulary:vocab_pick3_words: their lesson is the lesson part vocab-page inside each BUILD lesson.
ownerRulings.source: owner in the lead session, relayed by the lead 2026-11-07

ownerRulings.ruling: Q2: the page counts 4 / 6 / 8 (1 picture, 3 words at K-1 / grades 2-3 / grades 4-5) and 4 (Match 3) are the owner's: a value that prints fewer items than the default page for that reason is owner-ruled capacity (tests/fixtures/precritic/options-render.pins.json), not an H13 cost.
ownerRulings.source: owner in the lead session, relayed by the lead 2026-11-07

ownerRulings.ruling: OQ-1: when an item has no hundred, the base-ten one and ten blocks may be drawn with a larger unit; within ONE item every base-ten picture shares one scale (critic r4 OQ-1: a 2.5 mm unit made 'one' a speck in a grade 2 cell).
ownerRulings.source: owner ("yes to your recommendations", 2026-11-08), relayed by the lead

ownerRulings.ruling: R-1 (screen feedback only): after the pupil answers on screen, the picture's focal part (the boxed ?, the Out column, the bar's whole ...) gets a thick highlight and the correct word glows yellow. The question before the answer, and the printed pupil page, stay black and white; the printed KEY shows the same highlight in the single grey.
ownerRulings.source: owner, through the lead's suggested-answer questions, 2026-11-09 (after the r5 screenshots)

ownerRulings.ruling: R-2 (wrong answer on screen): show a short explanation, "The answer is <word>! <Word> means ...", one kid-friendly reason tied to the picture, in our own words, one per bank word, never contradicting the picture; read aloud automatically through the app's TTS (hints-speech.js speak), muted by the sound toggle. Check: every bank word has an explanation and each explanation names its word.
ownerRulings.source: owner, through the lead's suggested-answer questions, 2026-11-09 (after the r5 screenshots)

ownerRulings.ruling: O-1 (every screen host: practice card, online worksheet, quiz): the NEXT answer box is a thick BLUE outline that pulses gently (sample: inset 0 0 0 4px #1565d8 plus a pulsing inset ring rgba(21,101,216,.30), white fill). Yellow is kept ONLY for right-answer feedback (R-1). Built as ONE switch (a single custom property or body class, e.g. --mq-next-color) so going back to yellow is a one-line change. A wrong box keeps its red (R4-3); reduced motion is honoured; CSS additive.
ownerRulings.source: owner, directly to the lead after the samples, 2026-11-10

ownerRulings.ruling: O-2: a picture must mean only its word. 'digit' (H T O underlined) and 'place' (four empty boxes) are unclear: redraw them (digit: 472 with ONE digit circled and an arrow; place: a hundreds-tens-ones chart with one column heading shaded), and audit every picture the same way.
ownerRulings.source: owner, directly to the lead after the samples, 2026-11-10

ownerRulings.ruling: O-3: a picture must not fit any of its distractors (the 1-2-3 staircase read as 'column', not 'step'). Redraw 'step' as a short worked problem with Step 1 / Step 2 labels. Check V-AMBIG: each picture lists the words it could also show; an item whose bank holds one of them fails. The critic answers, for every picture, whether a pupil could defend another bank word.
ownerRulings.source: owner, directly to the lead after the samples, 2026-11-10

options: vocabTask (host vocab_grade_pictures): match3 | pick3, default match3, share key 6C (M / P). The host IS the Match 3 pictures skill (it defaults to that value: the owner rule's 'a skill that defaults to that option'); 1 picture, 3 words is the preset vocab_pick3_words. (A Match 3 preset was tried and dropped: ws-presets-unit fails a preset whose values change nothing.)
vocabGrade: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4, default 3 (the grades whose BUILD lessons have word sets today; K's BUILD lessons start in round 5). Share key 6D.
vocabSet: null (every word of the grade) | 0-10 (one BUILD lesson's six words, VOCAB_SETS position, append-only). Overrides the grade. Share key 6E.
